This describes linear compatible repair, not arbitrary proof transformations or a module quotient for an unverified PC pseudoideal.

claim.summary: For finite-dimensional U,V,W,Z, bilinear beta:U x V to W, tester Q:W to Z, clean C<=V and errors E, assume Q beta(U,C)=0, rank beta_e<dim U, ker Q intersect beta(U,e)=0 for every e, and beta_a injective on C for every nonzero a. For y=c+e, any nonzero solution Q beta(a,y)=0 kills e and uniquely recovers c by a second linear system. Standard error-correcting pairs satisfy these conditions when (A*B) perpendicular C, dim A>t, d(B-perp)>t and d(A)+d(C)>n, yielding O(n^3) field operations with bases supplied. Reed-Solomon evaluations work for n>=k+2t.
claim.assessment: Working self-contained synthesis of the established error-correcting-pair mechanism, passed by the sole medium reviewer; primary Definition 2.1 and Remark 2.2 of Pellikaan 1996 read. No new decoding algorithm claimed; faithful testers alone preserve action ranks.

claim.summary: In a finite-dimensional commutative Frobenius algebra A with fixed perfect pairing tau(ab), for every ideal I and element p, p outside I iff some f annihilates I and tau(fp) is nonzero. In a graded algebra with perfect A_j x A_(s-j) top pairings, homogeneous I and p of degree d allow f of degree s-d. This is a standard duality result, not a claim that bounded PC consequences form such an algebra.
claim.assessment: Working self-contained marked version of standard Frobenius duality, passed by the sole medium reviewer; no novelty or cheap PC pairing asserted.

claim.summary: For finitely many module errors vanishing after localization and a protected element surviving there, a product of denominators kills all errors and preserves the element, with additive filtration cost. Fixed linear common-kernel survival descends across finite field extensions without degree increase. Controls: in k[x,y]/(x,y)^2 no annihilator of (x) preserves y; in k[t]/t^(m+1) annihilators of (t) first occur at degree m; in k[u,v]/(u^2,v^2) useful f=u is nilpotent and localization at it is zero; rank-one error data at t distinct evaluation points still require locator degree at least t.
claim.assessment: Working elementary transfer proofs and exact algebraic counterexamples, passed by the sole medium reviewer. Finite-extension scope retained for the motivating use. Support, matrix rank and scalar extension alone give no universal cheap multiplier theorem.
